text:
NASA FIRMS showed no thermal detections on ASSET-F01 between 2026-09-23 and 2026-10-23. All four sensors (VIIRS S-NPP, NOAA-20, NOAA-21 and MODIS) covered every day of that period, so the lack of detections isn't a gap in coverage.

This doesn't prove that no fire occurred. Small, short-lived, cool or cloud-obscured fires can go undetected. The evidence also doesn't tell us whether there was any burned area, what caused any change on the property (harvest, fire, storm, clearing), or what happened outside this period.

This reflects what was known as of 2026-11-12 (evidence unit EU-FIRE-01, version 1, current). In short, no fire was detected, but a small or hidden fire can't be ruled out.
